_readme: Machine-readable citation registry for cis_rules.md. classify.py should have the LLM output rule IDs it applied (e.g. ["R6", "R11a"]), never free-text citations — resolve the actual HMRC source/URL by looking the ID up here. Keep this file's ids/titles in sync with cis_rules.md by hand; there is no auto-generation step in the POC.
